title: One-to-one (1:1)
summary: Pair each account with exactly one settings row via a UNIQUE FK.
description:
Pair each account with exactly one settings row via a UNIQUE FK.

Why: 1:1 needs an extra UNIQUE on the FK. Without it the database allows accidental 1:N, which breaks profile/settings style domains.
objectives: lab_settings (id PK, theme, account_id UNIQUE FK)
hints: UNIQUE on the FK makes it 1:1.
Read gate errors as cause→effect: each message names what Postgres still lacks.
why: 1:1 needs an extra UNIQUE on the FK. Without it the database allows accidental 1:N, which breaks profile/settings style domains.
pitfalls: Missing UNIQUE on the FK column.
